OAuth code/state is stdin-only; malformed/denied callbacks, token failures, rate limits, operation-lock contention, and provider accepted=false are explicit.
Playlist mutation requires private exact ordered item/count/snapshot readback before durable state advances.
Stale or reused daemon/lock PIDs are identity-checked and rejected; no source comment impersonates Venice or Renee.
